name: Palm Beach™ Shutters
description: Palm Beach™ Polysatin™ shutters are built to last with a UV-resistant compound that resists warping, cracking, fading, and discoloring—guaranteed for life.

benefits.text:
Benefits
One-Touch Closure
Exclusive SoftClose™ louvers feature one-touch control so louvers 
close softly and smoothly—and Quick Align™, for easy louver alignment. 
Superior Quality
Built to last, Palm Beach shutters are reinforced at major 
stress points for exceptional strength and stability.
Water Resilient
Our unique Polysatin™ compound resists water and stands up to humidity, 
making Palm Beach™ shutters perfect for bathrooms or kitchens.
Palm Beach™ Promise™
The Palm Beach Promise guarantees that shutters won’t warp, 
crack, fade, chip, peel or discolor for the life of the product. 
Energy Efficiency
Close shutter louvers to keep warm air out when it's hot 
and in when it's cold, reducing energy costs. 
Fire Retardant
Suitable for both residential and commercial applications, 
Palm Beach shutters are NFPA 701 flame retardant certified. 
UV Protection
When fully closed, Palm Beach shutters protect furniture, 
flooring and artwork from fading. 
Healthier Indoor Air 
Palm Beach™ shutters are GREENGUARD® Gold Certified for low indoor chemical 
emissions and GREENGUARD listed for resisting the growth of mold and mildew.

SoftClose™ Louvers
Enjoy smooth, controlled louver closure with a single touch.
Front Tilt Offset
Front tilt bar is offset to the left or right side of the panel 
for a less obstructed view.
Traditional Front Tilt 
Open and close louvers together using the tilt bar.
HiddenTilt™
Open and close louvers together with a single tilt; 
no tilt bar for unobstructed views.
Control Options

A Day With PowerView®  
10:30 PM Bedtime
Louvers close automatically for privacy and a perfect night’s sleep.
7:00 AM Morning
Schedule louvers to operate at your preferred wake-up time.
5 Minutes Before Sunset
Based on your local sunset time, louvers open to reveal your best view.
2:00 PM Afternoon
Louvers adjust to protect furnishings from harsh midday sunlight.
